title: Lazar's holographic book at S4

tellings.quote: It was some kind of a holographic book that as you opened up the pages, whatever the stories were became a hologram.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the 1980s at S4, a secret site near the Nevada base Area 51, says he saw a holographic book there: as you opened the pages, whatever the stories were turned into a hologram. Robert Bigelow, a Las Vegas businessman who has paid for UFO research, tells Michels this is what Lazar described to him.
